## IWorkerThreadWorkerClass type

Type-level carrier for the worker class a launched handle belongs to.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IWorkerThreadWorkerClass<TInit extends WorkerThreadInit> = {
    readonly __workerClass?: TInit;
};
```
**References:** [WorkerThreadInit](./worker-thread.workerthreadinit.md)

## Remarks

Purely phantom: the property is optional and never assigned at runtime. It exists so a `launchWorker()` result still knows which worker class produced it after it has crossed into an array, which is what lets `new WorkerThreadPool(handles)` infer the class instead of demanding a type argument.

A plain `WorkerThreadLaunch` is still assignable to this type — the target also requires the launch surface, so the optional-only "weak type" rule does not apply.
